newsitem.title: USA: Bank Plus names Gordon Smith chairman.
newsitem.headline: Bank Plus names Gordon Smith chairman.

text.p: Bank Plus Corp said Thursday that Gordon Smith, a director of Bank Plus since May 1996, has been named chairman of the Board, effective July 30.

The company issued a news release saying the previous chairman, Norman Barker, will continue to serve as a director, which he has done since May 1996 when Bank Plus became the holding company of Fidelity Federal Bank.
Bank Plus said Smith, 64, is chairman, founder and principal stockholder of Miller & Smith Inc, a real estate investment and construction company in the Washington, D.C. area.
